total_bases.probability_interpretation: P(official total bases >= 2 in this game | batter in confirmed starting lineup), frozen ridge-logistic output used as-is, no further calibration

hits.probability_interpretation: P(official hits >= 1 in this game | batter in confirmed starting lineup), frozen ridge-logistic output used as-is, no further calibration

strikeouts.note: logged only; never enters any arm or any promotion decision

gates.challenger_interval_rule: p_lo_challenger = p_challenger - max(0, p_champion - p_lo_champion) for the same line; no champion interval -> no challenger interval -> robust test fails closed

decision_unit: one champion export run R; the unit's games are those whose final pregame export (prepared_at <= first_pitch - 10 min) is R; N_u = champion rows with the lane status in R for those games

evaluation.horizon: all decision units from 2027 MLB Opening Day through the final 2027 regular-season day, unless Jacob fixes a different end date in writing BEFORE capture starts
evaluation.interim_looks: one safety-only look at mid-season (integrity and ROI-deterioration monitoring); no efficacy decision before the horizon
